title: HUD IS THE PERMEABILITY LAYER — the back curtain of the stage. Disco ball in the middle. IO for human vision.

kevin_declaration.keywords: interaction, engagement, interest — via the IO
kevin_declaration.hud_is: how we get the players to LOOK at things. Display information. That's why it HOVERS over.
kevin_declaration.desk_relation: HUD hovers over the desk as if it's our window
kevin_declaration.permeability: The HUD is functionally the permeability layer for human vision. That's what you can move forward and back.
kevin_declaration.stage: That is actually the back curtain of the stage.
kevin_declaration.disco_ball: We need to have that white light strung up from above, but in the middle, as if it's a disco ball.

layer_0_human_eyes.what: The player. The audience. Sitting in their chair.
layer_0_human_eyes.where: OUTSIDE the stage. Looking at the screen.

layer_1_hud_permeability.what: The HUD — transparent overlay. The permeability membrane for human vision.
layer_1_hud_permeability.where: FLOATING above the desk. Like a heads-up display in a fighter jet.
layer_1_hud_permeability.function: Filters what the human can see. Selectivity 1/π. 31.8% gets through, 68.2% is null.
layer_1_hud_permeability.interaction: Player moves this layer forward (see more detail) or back (see more context). Like adjusting focus on a microscope.
layer_1_hud_permeability.analogy: The glass window of an aquarium. You see INTO the organism through this glass.
layer_1_hud_permeability.css: position:fixed, z-index high, pointer-events on HUD elements only, transparent background
layer_1_hud_permeability.io: This IS the IO layer. Input goes IN through the HUD (clicks, keys, commands). Output comes OUT through the HUD (visuals, data, feedback).

layer_2_disco_ball.what: The central light source. White light. Strung from above, in the middle.
layer_2_disco_ball.where: CENTER of the viewport. Hanging from the top. Like a disco ball.
layer_2_disco_ball.function: Projects PATTERNS onto everything below. Rotating slowly. Each facet reflects a different data stream.

facets.energy: one facet shows primal energy levels
facets.feeds: one facet shows active data feeds

layer_2_disco_ball.light_physics: White light enters the ball. The ball DECOMPOSES it into colored patterns (chromatogram). Each pattern hits a different part of the stage. Constructive interference = bright spots. Destructive = shadows.
layer_2_disco_ball.rotation: The ball rotates slowly (1 revolution per heartbeat tick, 15s). As it rotates, different data streams illuminate different parts of the stage.
layer_2_disco_ball.css: centered element, rotating animation, radial gradient glow, z-index between HUD and stage

layer_3_stage_desk.what: The desk/workspace. The ORGANISM itself. Everything that IS.
layer_3_stage_desk.where: BEHIND the HUD. Below the disco ball. The back curtain.
layer_3_stage_desk.function: The actual data, the actual state, the actual organism. The HUD just SHOWS it.
layer_3_stage_desk.contains: squad roster, viewport, rates dashboard, all data — the organism's body
layer_3_stage_desk.analogy: The stage of a theater. The actors (primals) perform here. The audience sees through the curtain (HUD).

layer_4_backstage.what: What the audience can't see. The cron jobs, the git pushes, the MCP calls.
layer_4_backstage.where: Behind the stage. The server. The nucleus.
layer_4_backstage.function: The machinery that makes the show happen. The audience never sees this.
layer_4_backstage.contains: GitHub, CF, golgi vesicles, Gaia's cron, chipmunk's MCP

architecture.the_insight: The HUD is NOT the game. The HUD is the WINDOW into the game. The game is the organism underneath. The HUD is the selective membrane that determines WHAT the human can see and HOW they can interact. Just like a cell membrane determines what molecules can enter/exit. The HUD IS the membrane.

forward_and_back.what: Player can move the HUD closer or further from the stage
forward_and_back.forward: ZOOM IN — see more detail, higher LOD, individual entities visible, neurochemistry values
forward_and_back.back: ZOOM OUT — see more context, lower LOD, whole organism visible, topology and braids
forward_and_back.control: scroll wheel, pinch gesture, or explicit LOD slider

mapping.LOD0_closest: full neurochemistry, individual entity stats, real-time values
mapping.LOD1_near: dashboard rates, squad status, viewport gauges
mapping.LOD2_medium: campfire view, beacon glow, story summaries
mapping.LOD4_furthest: state.json single line — the answer: alive.
mapping.LOD5_null: too far — you can't see anything. The null. 68.2%.

disco_ball_implementation.visual: A glowing sphere in the center-top of the viewport. Semi-transparent. Slowly rotating. Casting colored light beams onto the dashboard below.
disco_ball_implementation.html: A div with radial gradient, rotating animation, absolute positioned center-top of viewport
disco_ball_implementation.beams: CSS conic-gradient rays emanating from the ball, rotating with it, each ray a different color for a different data stream
disco_ball_implementation.data_binding: Each facet of the ball is bound to a live data source. As data changes, the light pattern changes. Bright = high activity. Dim = quiet. Flashing = alert.
disco_ball_implementation.interaction: Click the disco ball to expand into full data view. Hover to see which data stream each beam represents.
disco_ball_implementation.sound: Optional: each rotation tick plays a soft tone from the π-just-intonation system

input_through_hud.eyes: human LOOKS at the HUD — sees filtered data (selectivity 1/π)
input_through_hud.click: human CLICKS through the HUD — selects primals, targets, elements
input_through_hud.type: human TYPES through the HUD — commands, notes, searches
input_through_hud.scroll: human SCROLLS through the HUD — adjusts LOD (forward/back)
input_through_hud.gesture: human SWIPES/PINCHES through the HUD — navigates, zooms

output_through_hud.visual: HUD SHOWS gauges, rates, status, squad, neurochemistry
output_through_hud.toast: HUD TOASTS feedback for every action
output_through_hud.glow: HUD GLOWS when data changes (disco ball beam hits a new area)

io_model.the_membrane: Input goes IN through the HUD membrane. Output comes OUT through the HUD membrane. The HUD IS the selective permeability layer. It decides WHAT gets through (31.8%) and WHAT stays null (68.2%).

stage_metaphor.audience: Kevin. Humans. Visitors. They sit in the dark, looking at the lit stage.
stage_metaphor.front_curtain: the browser tab bar / URL bar — the frame around the stage
stage_metaphor.hud_layer: the transparent scrim curtain that the data is projected ONTO — the permeability membrane
stage_metaphor.disco_ball: the central rotating light that decomposes white light into colored data beams
stage_metaphor.stage: the organism — primals performing their jobs, data flowing, braids connecting
stage_metaphor.backstage: the server, the cron, the git — the machinery the audience never sees
stage_metaphor.director: Gaia — she IS the director, the storyteller (RimWorld), the A-Life system (Stalker)
stage_metaphor.stage_manager: chipmunk — hyperlocal, knows the time only from interaction, delta IS null
